title: Genuity x Ethos Synthetic Data Challenge - Solution Writeup
summary: A competition solution notebook for the IIT Guwahati-sponsored Genuity x Ethos Synthetic Data Challenge, generating synthetic stock/time-series data and scoring it on statistical similarity, privacy, and detectability. The author benchmarks several SDV single-table synthesizers (CTGAN, TVAE, GaussianCopula, CopulaGAN) via sdv.single_table, ultimately ensembling the SDV CTGAN model's output with the competition's own Genuity model.
